name: amll-companion
description: Windows SMTC companion with AMLL lyrics
author: AMLL Companion contributors

scripts.start: npm run build:bridge && npm run build && dotnet run --project native/Companion.csproj -c Release
scripts.test:browser: node tests/search-headless.mjs && node tests/metadata-headless.mjs && node tests/wrapping-headless.mjs && node tests/lyric-transition-headless.mjs
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build:bridge && npm run build && dotnet build native/Companion.csproj -c Release && dotnet build native/SmtcFixture/SmtcFixture.csproj -c Release && node tests/native.mjs
